title: SWAT+原生水文参数目录
interpretation: model_absolute_bounds从现有对应版本模型cal_parms.cal读取，运行时重新读取用户模型字典；不是SWAT-CUP统一标准率定范围。suggested_search为项目探索建议，不代表官方建议或水文合理性已验证。 各参数实际支持的版本以其model_absolute_bounds键为准；新增项不自动适用于旧版。

62.0.1.role: Original model dictionary used in the 62.0.1 adapter verification.
62.0.1.consolidation_note: On 2026-10-21 all 221 parsed dictionary entries were compared and found identical. Current input_sources now points to the retained project. Original trial evidence and its recorded paths have not been rewritten.

parameters.label: SCS曲线数

suggested_search.basis: 探索性起始范围，非官方通用推荐；需按流域资料、初值与敏感性调整

parameters.relative_change_convention: pctchg: new = old * (1 + value / 100); abschg: new = old + value; model absolute bounds clip results
parameters.note: 保留各HRU初始差异；10表示增加10%，不是SWAT-CUP的0.1相对系数。

verification.limits: 组合试验成功不证明每项参数均有效；各参数是否敏感取决于流域、时间尺度及过程是否激活；没有修改编译程序输出内部参数。

version_62_0_1.limits: Combined execution does not establish each parameter response. CHN had no outlet change at the written precision in this case; unsupported process activation or low sensitivity must not be mistaken for an integration failure. Post-change internal parameter values are not dumped.
version_62_0_1.binary_smoke_scope: 26 parameters together; 1990-1991 with one warmup year
